entries.prompt: Edit ONLY the composition of the first attached isolated mask image, preserving exactly the mask design, viewing angle, proportions, details, three forehead claw gouges, dark eye apertures, side round ports, open U-shaped lower mouth, worn silver-gray paint and faint blue/turquoise patina. This is the source-faithful Ahab NECA SDCC2014 photographed-sculpt version A, with the second attached official photograph only as the identity reference; do not add features from the wearer. Reduce the complete isolated mask uniformly to 85% of its current size and recenter it within an otherwise unchanged square transparent canvas. The topmost sculpted edge and bottom tips MUST each be at least 120 pixels from the top/bottom edges on a roughly 1254px canvas, aiming for a centered mask no taller than 1000px, approximately 78 to 80% of the canvas height. Leave 10% truly transparent clear margin around all outer edges. Keep the whole mask with no clipping. Keep the mouth opening truly transparent, with NO wearer flesh, teeth or mandibles. Output exactly one complete mask, native transparent PNG.
entries.sourceGenerationPrompt: Create exactly ONE isolated removable biomask, extracted faithfully from the photographed 2014 NECA SDCC exclusive Fire and Stone AHAB figure. This is version A, a source-faithful isolated reconstruction of THIS PHOTOGRAPHED SCULPT AND PAINT EDITION, not Ultimate 2017 and not a redesign based on comic lore. Primary camera and silhouette are the nearly frontal mask on the MAIN FULL FIGURE in reference image ahab-sdcc-1.jpg: its face is tilted slightly downward so a small amount of top dome is visible. Use the actual MASK worn on the main figure, not the inset unmasked head. The other two actual product photos support visible borders and side fittings only; DO NOT rotate to another view or invent a back/hidden interior. Preserve the broad rounded tapered silver-gray dome, subtly scalloped/back upper rim where visible, heavy swept downward brow ridges forming a central V, narrow dark black eye apertures, the precise three long diagonal gouges on the viewer-left/central forehead, the sculpted cheek recesses, the circular silver-gray lower cheek fittings and the two long descending cheek prongs that frame the central inverted-U mouth opening. Copy the source's worn silver-gray metal paint, faint blue/turquoise weathering and restrained dark scratches; no gold, no extra bright LEDs, no glowing eyes, no invented glyphs, no extra horns, no extra vents, no teeth added to the metal. Preserve the photographed sculpt's imperfect hand-painted/toy material character, surface roughness and gentle product lighting; do not upgrade it to polished chrome or add cinematic embellishment. Remove the entire wearer: no flesh, no eyes behind lenses, no organic mandibles, no real teeth or tusks, no head, no neck, no dreadlocks, no skull necklace, no straps dangling beyond the actual mask, no caster, no body, no fabric and no weapon. In the open U-shaped mouth area, remove the wearer's mouth and teeth entirely, leaving true transparent empty space bounded only by the existing metal mask edges; retain only genuinely sculpted metallic inner edge detail visible in the photo. Keep the eye recesses dark black rather than filling them with biological eyes. Output one complete mask only on a truly transparent background, no shadow on background, no floor, no backplate, no vignette, no caption, no UI, no marks outside the object. Center the full mask with its longer dimension at 78 to 80 percent of the square canvas, preserving at least 10 percent clear transparent margin on every outer side. Sharp clean complete silhouette, no clipping. Do not show multiple angles, alternate masks or a sheet.

entries.prompt: Create exactly ONE version B of the isolated Ahab biomask in the FIRST attachment, using Predator Hunting Grounds quality game-asset art direction while preserving this exact photographed 2014 NECA SDCC Fire and Stone mask design. The first image is the accepted isolated version A and is the controlling silhouette/camera/composition reference. The following three original product photographs establish identity and visible source paint/sculpt, NOT an alternate pose. Keep EXACTLY the same slightly downward-facing nearly frontal view, dome shape, crown edge, proportions, three diagonal long claw gouges on the viewer-left/central forehead, swept raised brow with central V, narrow BLACK eyes, cheek grooves, small side round ports, metallic inner edge detail, two long lower cheek prongs and transparent open central U-shaped mouth. Maintain the same weathered silver-gray base with subtle blue/turquoise patina and tiny source-visible dark blemishes. No color redesign. Keep the entire mask at precisely the same position and scale as version A, about77-80% of the square canvas height with at least10% clear transparent margin above and below. Upgrade only the surface rendering and light: high-quality realistic realtime PBR game material, neutral soft key light from upper-left/front and gentle front fill, legible sculpted planes, controlled fine grain and roughness, restrained worn metallic reflections. Reduce coarse pebbled toy-paint grain into controlled plausible metal microtexture while preserving the existing scratches/patina locations. Avoid flat all-chrome shine, over-sharpening, oversaturation and noisy pitted texture. The angular brow and gouges must stay crisp and source-matched; do not beautify or symmetrize asymmetric scars. The lower U opening remains empty true alpha. No biological teeth, no wearer flesh, no eyes behind lenses, no mandibles, no hair/dreadlocks, no body, no neck, no shoulder caster, no skull necklace, no fabric, no weapons. Do not invent a back rim, bottom bridge, face grille, extra teeth, holes, screws, gold trims, glyphs, horns or glowing lights. No labels, text, UI, border, floor, background shadow or vignette. Output exactly one complete isolated native transparent PNG mask, no contact sheet or additional view.
